source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-10

procedures.title: Door window: adjust
steps: Fore/aft: loosen the 2 inner hex bolts at the top of the plate assembly (View A) and the 1 hex bolt at the channel bottom.
Move the channel as far as the slotted holes allow, then tighten.

procedures.title: Door hinges: adjust door
steps: Take off the door trim panel.
Scribe around the striker's circular flange on the lock pillar, then remove the striker bolt.
For up/down: remove the hinge cover (2 screws) to reach the upper hinge screws.
For in/out and fore/aft: remove the instrument panel (left door only) or right dash pad (right door), cowl kick panel, air inlet duct and radio speaker to reach the hinge screws.
Adjust the door as needed, never letting it hang unsupported on a single hinge.
notes: See figure 24 in the manual. Fore/aft = slide door in the slotted holes in the hinge pillar; in/out = add/remove shims between hinge pillar and front hinge straps; up/down = rear hinge straps in the inner door panel slots. Door position also depends on striker position.
Figures 11-14 (windshield weatherstrip and molding removal) are on this page.
